split.gap_backtest: holdout only; synthetic contiguous masks, target is existing local pressure

quality_control: Controls require pressure 900-1050 hPa, barometer 930-1080 hPa, outTemp -40..45 C and usUnits=16. Gap windows use contiguous five-minute records. Stable/fast_change split is based on absolute local pressure change across +/-5 minutes >0.8 hPa. Independent station/reanalysis sources are comparison references, not fully independent ground truth; ERA5 may assimilate CHMI.
